title: Interior gravitational perturbations to naked singularities of a scalar field
summary: For the $k$-self-similar naked singularity solutions of Einstein--scalar field equations constructed by Christodoulou, we construct a family of interior gravitational perturbations leading to trapped surface formation that remain large but finite at the threshold Hölder regularity, while converging to zero in all regularities below the threshold. This extends the interior spherically symmetric result below the threshold in \cite{Li25} to non-spherically symmetric setting.
